evidence_required: Source code; two consecutive runs showing drift -> fixed -> in sync (second apply plans zero actions); audit lines; L2 manifest fields.

marking.criterion: Reads state through machine-readable interfaces (ip -j, ethtool -i, ibv_devinfo, sysfs speed)
Exit codes 0 in sync / 1 drift / 2 cannot determine
Validates without mutating by default (dry run)
--apply touches only the IP MTU of backend NICs and the second run is a no-op
One JSON audit line per check and per action (target, key, before, after, result)
Missing tool or device reported as cannot-determine, never as in sync

title: Idempotent node/network configuration validator
